spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership is backend-enforced. It reads SpellBook's own records and never calls the marketplace.
Page with cursor until nextCursor is null. nextCursor is always null when itemIds is set.
observedQuantity, observedAskUsd, observedBestBidUsd, and observedAgrees come from the last marketplace read, at observedAt. They are null before the first read.
confirmed is true when the marketplace accepted the current desired quantity and ask. It does not prove a buyer can see the listing now.
lastError pending_reconciliation means a write went out and SpellBook has not read its result yet.

itemsWithoutTarget reasons: not_found means no such copy in this workspace. not_a_card, archived, not_owned_or_listed, reserved, and not_received mean the copy is not sellable stock. not_authorized means the seller has not authorized that copy for this channel. not_live_on_channel means the channel needs a live listing elsewhere first. no_listing_key means the venue cannot list that copy, for example a non-English copy or a game the venue does not carry. not_in_misprint_catalog means Misprint has no approved product for that printing. not_managed means the seller has not handed that ManaPool listing to SpellBook Finance to manage, or no single owned ManaPool account is bound. lane_off means the lane is disabled. not_planned means the copy qualifies and the next planner run has not placed it yet.

Each Misprint desiredAskUsd is the highest TCGplayer ask SpellBook Finance holds among the copies in that listing, raised to lane.askFloorUsd. A target with a null desiredAskUsd has no TCGplayer ask and does not list.
It returns facts and never recommends a price, a mode, or which copies to list.

description: Read the listings SpellBook Finance plans on one channel-lane marketplace for a workspace. It returns the lane's enabled flag, mode, and ask floor, then one target per listing: the card, the copies it holds, the desired quantity and ask, whether the marketplace confirmed both, and what SpellBook last read from the marketplace for it. Pass itemIds to ask about specific scanned copies. Each named copy no target holds comes back in itemsWithoutTarget with a reason. Call it after spellbook_marketplace_onboarding when a seller asks what will list, what is live, or why a card did not list. Call spellbook_channel_lane_set to change the lane's mode or ask floor.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page, passed back unchanged. Omit to start from the first page.

itemIds.description: Item ids of copies to look up, 1 to 100. The reply holds every target that contains one of them and a reason for each one no target holds. Omit to page through every target.

limit.description: Maximum targets per page, 1 to 200. Omit for 100. Ignored when itemIds is set.

marketplace.description: The channel-lane marketplace whose listing targets to read.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose listing targets to read. Required.

name: spellbook_channel_lane_targets
